ABSTRACT: 1,1-Difluoroallenes underwent regioselective [2 + 2] and
2] cycloadditions with aldehydes using Au(I) catalysts. An AuCl catalyst
enabled an α,β-selective [2 + 2] cycloaddition of 1,1-difluoroallenes, yielding

catalyst facilitated an α,γ-selective [3 + 2] cycloaddition, followed by
dehydrofluorination to produce aromatized 2-fluorofurans. DFT calculations
(B3LYP level) suggested that the former reaction proceeded through Au(III)-
containing metallacycles, while the latter involved cyclic Au(I) carbenoids.
